subject: DI03005061

body.en:
Definition and principle

The limiting reactant is the reactant that would be exhausted first at complete reaction for the specified stoichiometry. An excess reactant is supplied above its stoichiometric requirement relative to the limiting-reactant feed. Reactant amounts must first be converted to moles.

Balance method and important conditions

For a balanced equation, compare available moles divided by the positive stoichiometric requirement coefficient. The smallest value limits the reaction extent. Excess percent normally refers to the amount required to consume all limiting-reactant feed, not the amount actually consumed at incomplete conversion. State an alternative basis if the question explicitly uses one.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત

આપેલી stoichiometry મુજબ complete reaction માં સૌપ્રથમ પૂરો થાય તે Limiting Reactant છે. Limiting-reactant feed માટેની stoichiometric requirement કરતાં વધારે આપેલો reactant Excess Reactant છે. પ્રથમ reactant amounts ને moles માં convert કરો.

Balance Method તથા જરૂરી Conditions

Balanced equation માટે available moles ને positive stoichiometric requirement coefficient થી ભાગો. નાનું value reaction extent ને limit કરે છે. Excess percent સામાન્ય રીતે આખો limiting-reactant feed consume કરવા જરૂરી amount પર છે, incomplete conversion માં actual consumed amount પર નહીં. Question અલગ basis આપે તો તે સ્પષ્ટ લખો.

સમીકરણો / સંકેતો

body.en:
Definition and principle

Conversion is the fraction of a specified reactant feed that reacts. Yield measures desired product relative to a declared theoretical amount; the basis may be reactant fed or reactant consumed. Selectivity compares desired and undesired product formation on a declared molar or stoichiometrically normalized basis.

Balance method and important conditions

Never use product mass divided by reactant mass as a universal reaction yield. Balance the reaction and apply molecular weights first. For parallel reactions, write separate extents and sum reactant consumption. Conversion need not equal yield. Unreacted reactants, inerts and all formed products belong in outlet composition calculations; state wet or dry gas basis.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત

ચોક્કસ reactant feed માંથી react થયેલો fraction Conversion છે. Desired product ને declared theoretical amount સાથે સરખાવતું Yield છે; basis reactant fed અથવા consumed હોઈ શકે છે. Selectivity માં desired તથા undesired product formation ને declared molar અથવા stoichiometrically normalized basis પર સરખાવો.

Balance Method તથા જરૂરી Conditions

Product mass/reactant mass ને universal yield ન માનો. પ્રથમ reaction balance અને molecular weights લાગુ કરો. Parallel reactions માટે અલગ extents લઈને reactant consumption ઉમેરો. Conversion અને yield જરૂરી નથી કે સમાન હોય. Outlet composition માં unreacted reactants, inerts તથા બધા products ગણો; gas માટે wet/dry basis લખો.

body.en:
Calculation workflow

Balance the reaction. Convert feeds to moles. Find limiting reactant from n/stoichiometric requirement. Declare conversion, yield and selectivity bases. Use one extent per independent reaction. Include residual reactants, inert and all products in the outlet total. Check atomic or equivalent balances; do not force inlet moles to equal outlet moles.

How to practise honestly

Rework the solved cases without seeing the answer, then compare equations, units and closure. Change one input at a time and recheck feasibility. These are study exercises, not laboratory readings.
body.gu:
Calculation Workflow

Reaction balance કરો. Feeds ને moles માં ફેરવો.n/stoichiometric requirement પરથી limiting reactant મેળવો. Conversion, yield તથા selectivity bases લખો. દરેક independent reaction માટે અલગ extent લો. Outlet total માં residual reactants, inert તથા બધા products ગણો. Atomic/equivalent balances check કરો; inlet તથા outlet moles ને બળજબરીથી સમાન ન માનો.

પ્રમાણિક Practice કેવી રીતે કરવી

પ્રથમ answer જોયા વગર solved cases ફરી કરો. પછી equations, units તથા closure સરખાવો. એક સમયે એક input બદલીને feasibility ફરી check કરો. આ study exercises છે, laboratory readings નથી.
